payload.title: Reader feedback through Papyrus core blocks, driven by Shipped
payload.description:
Planning draft (2026-11-07). Shipped is the pilot for voting, comments, flags and Proposals (reader-steering plugin in papyrus.config.ts; islands hand-placed through _island() in web/hooks.py, nine call sites). Papyrus plans to make these catalogue blocks placed from data (Papyrus board: epic PPY-149b82 "Reader feedback as catalogue blocks in core", under initiative PPY-25ffa3). Shipped says what is generic and what is Shipped-specific, and swaps its hand-placed islands for the blocks in small slices.
Not included: the product shape of Shipped itself (see the separate story on what Shipped keeps).
Done when: Shipped renders every reader control from core blocks, with its pages visually unchanged and the _island markup removed from hooks.
